title: 90-Day Career Reset
h1: Staying in a job you have outgrown is a decision. Make it for ninety days, with a plan.
sub: Thirteen weeks, one career move a week, with five honest decision gates along the way.

faq.q: How much time does it need?
faq.a: Day 0 takes about twenty minutes. After that it is one move a week, checked off and written up in a line.
People who have outgrown a role and want to test a direction without quitting.

faq.q: Do I need to quit to use it?
faq.a: No. It is built to run alongside your current job.
Set points in the plan where you answer honestly whether to continue, change or stop. There are five.

faq.q: Can I print it or use it on a tablet?
faq.a: Yes. It is a PDF, so any PDF app works. It prints on US Letter or on A4 at fit to page.

faq.q: Is this employment or legal advice?
faq.a: No. General education, not employment or legal advice.
